data.title: Hospital Wards and Clinic Operations
data.summary: Management-simulation hospital fit-out: ward, diagnostics, theatre, pharmacy, reception, staff, ambulance bay and a modular partition kit in one bright eight-colour palette.
data.description: A clean, working civilian hospital for a management simulation, built for legibility from a 30 degree overhead camera: chamfered solid volumes, clear colour coding and mid-low triangle counts. Sixty-seven designs plus functional and cosmetic variants cover ward furniture with hinged bed sections, imaging gantries with real bored openings, a theatre set with a named tilt table and articulated surgical lamp, pharmacy and laboratory casework, reception and waiting furniture, back-of-house service equipment, an ambulance with named wheel and door nodes, and a 2 m modular partition, floor and ceiling kit with wall-run ports. Static CC0 geometry prepared for human review.

starterScene.title: Six Bed Ward Bay (Hospital Wards and Clinic Operations)
starterScene.summary: A 12 by 8 metre six-bed ward bay: two facing rows of three beds, each with a bedside locker, over-bed table, drip stand, vital-signs monitor, bedhead services panel and cubicle curtain, inside a partition shell with a glazed doorway. Back-of-house equipment and mobility aids...

Back-of-house equipment and mobility aids stand in the central corridor. Ceilings are omitted so the layout reads from an overhead camera.
